name: Facet
text: Make the legend a sticky panel anchored to the left edge of the graph. It stays visible at all times so users never hunt for it, which speeds up interpretation and keeps the interface lively. The trade-off is less screen space for data, but clarity beats density when users need to make quick, confident decisions.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A sticky legend still risks crowding the graph when users zoom into dense data clusters, forcing them to scroll or squint—speed and clarity collapse under their own weight. Better: a collapsible sidebar legend triggered by a persistent, small icon; it stays out of the way until needed, then vanishes again. Test it: measure time-to-interpret with and without zoom at 100% and 200% scale.

name: Facet
text:
Choose a floating legend that collapses into a compact icon when the user zooms. It stays visible but compact until expanded, keeping the graph uncluttered during dense views while preserving instant access to the legend. The trade-off is a slight delay when expanding the legend, but clarity and speed win when users need to interpret data quickly without hunting for controls.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A floating legend that collapses still risks users missing the icon entirely when they’re deep in dense data—clarity collapses if the affordance isn’t visible. Better: a sticky sidebar legend that shrinks to a thin strip when zoomed, keeping the icon always in view without crowding the graph. Settle it with user tests: track time-to-interpret and error rates when users switch between dense and sparse views.

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Default to a sticky sidebar legend that shrinks to a thin strip when zoomed, keeping the icon always visible without crowding the graph.

Result: A legend that is always accessible but space-efficient, balancing clarity and density. Owned by Facet.
